HighPoint hired her to overhaul their store layout style—and her seasonal displays quickly became a local highlight.

Current Role at HighPoint:
Every holiday, sale, or featured item display is Mira’s doing—from the hand-lettered chalk signs to the pyramid of candy-colored soda bottles that somehow always look too perfect to touch. She collaborates directly with Veronica on big seasonal campaigns, and while their personalities are different, there's a mutual respect for excellence.

Current Arc/Desire:
Mira’s work is her safe space—but she’s starting to crave more creative freedom and recognition. She’s debating proposing a full brand-wide aesthetic refresh and stepping into a regional display leadership role. Quietly, she wonders if she has the courage to take that leap—or to let anyone into her carefully ordered world.
